ui.title: Recon — Control
ui.subtitle: Starts a scan with the same spec as the CLI. Phase 6 run history stays available.
ui.har_note: Without a file the scan runs as usual. With a HAR, in-scope URLs and JS join the same run before the AI step (32 MB per file). HAR account B is the same journey with another test account.
ui.cloud: Cloud AI (Groq, NVIDIA; Gemini and DeepSeek off)
ui.cloud_note: Opt-in. Hosts and IPs become tokens before the request. Ask the model stays on the local model. Active: Groq and NVIDIA. Gemini and DeepSeek are off for now (quota/balance). Keys live only in the environment, never in the spec.
ui.ai_delay_note: Default 2000 ms (2 s). Minimum 10 ms, maximum 10 minutes (600000 ms). Applies to Ollama and cloud.
ui.consult_after: . This does not run the scan classification or route step.
ui.candidates_note: corr/ joins are not confirmed CVEs. Use them as a review queue.
ui.ai_busy: The model is busy with the scan.
ui.over_budget: Prompt is over the input budget.
ui.no_delta: No delta stored for this run.
ui.no_ai: This run has no model analysis yet.
ui.report_totals: {assets} assets · {findings} findings · the table shows up to 100 rows
ui.drafts_note: One draft per reportable cluster, in submission form. Coverage candidates stay in the run notebook.
ui.delete_confirm: Delete run {id} ({target})? This deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

ai.classify_intro: Classify each finding. Reply only with JSON in the form {"items":[{"finding_id":1,"decision":"keep","reason":"one sentence"}]}
ai.classify_decision: decision is keep, review, or false_positive.
ai.classify_reason: The reason is one sentence in English.
ai.routes: Extract HTTP routes from the JavaScript. Reply only with JSON. The root object has only the key routes. Each routes item is an object with path. If there is no route, the reply is exactly {"routes":[]}.
ai.tech_intro: Review this list of libraries and versions. Reply only with JSON {"items":[{"name":"lib","version":"1.0","note":"one sentence"}]}. Do not mention hosts, URLs, or the target.
ai.draft_intro: Write summary, impact, and evidence_notes as JSON. title and steps will be replaced. Do not invent paths. Reply only {"title":"...","summary":"...","impact":"...","steps":["..."],"evidence_notes":"..."}.

cli.check: Checks the image and does not contact targets.
cli.har_b: Optional HAR of the same journey with another test account.
cli.webhook: External alert. Not part of this phase.
cli.lang: Run language: en-US, pt-BR, or es-ES. Default pt-BR.
cli.cloud: Send classification, routes, and stack to the cloud after pseudonymizing the target. Groq and NVIDIA; Gemini and DeepSeek are off for now.
cli.ai_delay: Wait after each AI response before the next prompt. Default 2000 ms; from 10 ms to 600000 ms (10 min).
cli.cloud_mode: sequential: next IA if one fails. parallel: several prompts at once across keyed providers.
cli.webhook_msg: Webhook is not part of this phase.
cli.cloud_msg: Cloud provider has no key configured.
cli.run_doc: Runs the pipeline, the local analysis, and stores the run in SQLite.
cli.resume_doc: Continues a run from the first phase that is not ok.
cli.stop_doc: Asks a running scan to stop.
cli.export_doc: Writes the consolidated report as PDF or Word.
cli.ai_doc: Classifies stored findings and extracts routes from downloaded JS.
cli.draft: Export one cluster draft instead of the run notebook.

export.bad_format: Invalid format. Use pdf or docx.

subfinder.what: Passive subdomain enumeration. If the output is empty or the process fails, it retries with -all. Keys in config/subfinder/provider-config.yaml are optional.
subfinder.input: Only the scan domain. It does not read a file from another component.
subfinder.output: subdomains/subfinder.txt. In-scope names go into subdomains/all_subs.txt.
subfinder.place: Runs in parallel with amass, assetfinder, and crtsh. dnsx resolves the merged list. An isolated failure does not abort the run.
subfinder.correlation: Names feed the corr/shadow-host baseline: a hostname read from JavaScript and absent from all_subs. A name found only by this source is not a candidate yet.

amass.what: Passive enumeration with amass enum -passive, a 5-minute timeout, and resolvers 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8. This run has no brute force and no ASN or CIDR output.
amass.input: The scan domain and tools.amass.timeout_minutes. config/amass/config.ini is optional.
amass.output: subdomains/amass.raw and the amass/ directory. Filtered names go into all_subs.txt.
amass.place: Second passive source, in parallel. It feeds dnsx through the merged list.
amass.correlation: It joins the corr/shadow-host baseline. Overlap with subfinder, assetfinder, and crtsh is not published.

assetfinder.what: Lists subdomains with assetfinder --subs-only, limited to 180 seconds.
assetfinder.input: The scan domain. No input file and no key.
assetfinder.place: Third passive source, in parallel. It feeds dnsx.
assetfinder.correlation: It joins the corr/shadow-host baseline. A name exclusive to this source is not a candidate yet.

crtsh.what: Queries Certificate Transparency. It is a curl to crt.sh, not a dedicated binary. It reads name_value and strips the *. prefix.
crtsh.input: The scan domain. No key. Timeout of 120 seconds.
crtsh.output: subdomains/crtsh.json and subdomains/crtsh.txt, merged into all_subs.txt.
crtsh.place: Fourth passive source. A name dnsx does not resolve stays only in all_subs and does not go to httpx.
crtsh.correlation: A name whose only source is crt.sh and that dnsx resolves becomes corr/crtsh-only. A crt.sh-only name without DNS is a checklist count, not a finding.

dnsx.what: Resolves A and CNAME records for the name list and probes wildcard-probe on the domain. Hosts whose only IP is the wildcard IP leave the list.
dnsx.input: subdomains/all_subs.txt. It requires at least one subdomain source. On a literal target it stores that host and does not call the binary.
dnsx.output: dns/resolved.txt, dns/resolved_hosts.txt, and dns/cnames.tsv. MX and TXT are not requested.
dnsx.place: The only input to httpx. A dnsx failure, on A or on CNAME, aborts the run.
dnsx.correlation: A third-party CNAME whose host is not in live_hosts gets a nuclei pass with only the takeover tag, up to 30 hosts. What does not fit becomes corr/dangling-cname.

httpx.what: Probes resolved hosts for status, title, technology, and redirects. It classifies 2xx/3xx, 401, and 403. Out-of-scope URLs are dropped after the probe.
httpx.input: dns/resolved_hosts.txt. Threads, timeout, and retries come from the spec.
httpx.output: live/httpx.json, live/fingerprints.jsonl, live/live_hosts.txt (2xx/3xx), live/unauthorized.txt (401), and live/forbidden.txt (403).
httpx.place: katana and nuclei read only live_hosts.txt. dorks reads the fingerprint for extra queries. 401 and 403 are not crawled or scanned.
httpx.correlation: Feeds corr/tech-panel, corr/js-on-gated-host, corr/idor-candidate, corr/archive-still-live, and corr/delta-unscanned.

katana.what: Active crawl of live hosts, depth 3 by default, with -jc to follow JavaScript.
katana.input: live/live_hosts.txt, only 2xx/3xx. It does not receive 401, 403, or the subdomain list.
katana.output: urls/katana.txt, merged into urls/all_urls.txt with katana provenance. URLs pass through the idor, swagger, graphql, debug, and upload buckets.
katana.place: What the application links today. js_httpx and js_curl read all_urls.txt.
katana.correlation: An archive URL that katana also saw is not corr/archive-still-live. A graphql, debug, or upload URL that is live or in the HAR becomes a candidate.

gau.what: Pulls historical URLs from Wayback, Common Crawl, AlienVault, and URLScan, with gau --subs. config/gau.toml is optional.
gau.input: The apex domain and hosts from dns/resolved_hosts.txt, up to 30 names. It does not read katana output.
gau.output: urls/gau.txt, merged into all_urls.txt with gau provenance and reclassified into buckets.
gau.place: Runs beside katana and waybackurls. Archive-only URLs are probed again by httpx, up to 200.
gau.correlation: A URL with gau provenance, without katana, present in urls/archive_live.txt becomes corr/archive-still-live.

waybackurls.what: Pulls Wayback Machine URLs for the domain. A single source, narrower than gau.
waybackurls.input: The apex domain and hosts from dns/resolved_hosts.txt, up to 30 names.
waybackurls.output: urls/waybackurls.txt, merged into all_urls.txt with waybackurls provenance.
waybackurls.place: Second archive source, in parallel with gau. It joins the same archive probe.
waybackurls.correlation: Joins corr/archive-still-live together with gau, through urls/archive_live.txt.

dorks.what: Builds site: queries from the templates and, when the fingerprint matches, extra queries by technology (Jenkins, GitLab, WordPress, phpMyAdmin, Jira). Runs go-dork, Bing by default, filters hits to scope, and probes them with httpx.
dorks.input: The domain, live/fingerprints.jsonl, and httpx enabled. Shodan only with a key. Parameters: engine, delay, max_queries, max_results, and proxy.
dorks.output: dorks/queries.txt, raw.txt, hits.txt, live.txt (2xx/3xx), and gated.txt (401/403). Hits enter all_urls.txt with dorks provenance.
dorks.place: After the URL phase and before JavaScript. A go-dork or httpx failure aborts the run.
dorks.correlation: A sensitive live hit becomes corr/dork-live-exposure. A live hit missing from the crawl becomes corr/dork-unknown-to-crawl. Live OpenAPI becomes corr/openapi-live. A 401 or 403 hit joins the same candidates as unauthorized.txt and forbidden.txt.

js_httpx.what: From collected URLs, keeps those that look like JavaScript and probes at most 200 with httpx, keeping responses of 200.
js_httpx.input: urls/all_urls.txt, already including katana, gau, waybackurls, and dork hits. The HAR runs after this phase and is not included here.
js_httpx.place: Decides what js_curl downloads. If this is off and js_curl is on, curl receives the first 200 script URLs without this filter.
js_httpx.correlation: With js_curl on, it probes one extra hop of referenced scripts that are not yet in all_urls.txt, up to 50. Without both enabled, the hop does not run.

js_curl.what: Downloads each live script into js/content. Extracts /api/ and /vN/ paths and looks for secrets. The secret is redacted, with a fingerprint, and is not a finding by itself. A source map is downloaded only when the host matches the script and the URL is in scope, up to 20.
js_curl.input: js/js_live.txt when js_httpx is on. Timeout of 15 seconds per URL. The extra hop requires js_httpx and js_curl.
js_curl.output: js/content/*.js, maps in js/content/*.map, js/endpoints.txt, and js/secrets.jsonl.
js_curl.place: Correlation and the model read these artifacts. It is the bridge between the crawl and candidates that come from front-end code.
js_curl.correlation: A path on a 401/403 host becomes corr/js-on-gated-host. An /api/ or /vN/ path absent from all_urls.txt becomes corr/js-not-crawled, up to 80. A hostname outside all_subs becomes corr/shadow-host. A secret with the same fingerprint in a HAR becomes corr/secret-live-session.

nuclei.what: Runs pinned http, dns, and ssl templates against live hosts. Default severity: critical, high, medium. Tags: cve, exposure, misconfiguration, takeover, tech, config, default-login. A short pass, takeover tag only, covers third-party CNAMEs outside live_hosts, up to 30 hosts.
nuclei.input: live/live_hosts.txt and, when present, nuclei/takeover_hosts.txt with third-party CNAMEs. Requires httpx. It does not receive a cookie or Authorization. After the HAR, capture URLs that are not in live_hosts get a pass without a session, up to 50.
nuclei.output: nuclei/results.jsonl, nuclei/takeover.jsonl, and nuclei/har.jsonl. Each line becomes a finding. A binary failure aborts the phase.
nuclei.place: Last collection phase. The HAR pass runs only after ingest. Correlation and the model read the three JSONL files.
nuclei.correlation: With a HAR on the same host: corr/cors-credentialed and corr/retire-cve. A new live host without a finding against the previous run becomes corr/delta-unscanned. A third-party CNAME that did not fit the takeover pass becomes corr/dangling-cname.

title.secret_live: [Exposed Secret] in a live session on {asset}

remediate.dangling_cname: Remove the dangling CNAME or claim the third-party resource.
remediate.secret: Rotate the secret and remove it from public JavaScript.
remediate.cors: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to explicit origins and do not pair * with credentials.
remediate.jwt_none: Reject tokens with alg=none and sign with an asymmetric algorithm.
remediate.panel: Restrict the panel or spec to an internal network and require authentication.
remediate.retire: Upgrade the JavaScript library to a version without the CVE.
remediate.idor: Authorize the object for the authenticated user, not only the id in the URL.
remediate.generic: Fix according to the Nuclei template description and the CWE reference.

step.cname: Resolve the CNAME for {host} and confirm the third-party target is claimed.

catalog.summary_fallback: {name} on {asset}. Recon signal, no automatic exploitation.
catalog.impact_fallback: Impact depends on the asset remaining reachable and uncontrolled. Confirm before submitting.
catalog.evidence_fallback: Evidence is in the run artifact. No secret in the clear.
